name: PJSC MMC NORILSK NICKEL ADR (10
summary: PJSC MMC Norilsk Nickel is a diversified mining and metallurgical company, the world's largest producer of palladium and high-grade nickel. The company's operations include exploration, mining, smelting, refining and marketing of nickel, palladium, platinum, copper, and other metals. The company is headquartered in Moscow, Russia.
